scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel INFO --pool solo
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy app tests benchmarks alembic/env.py && uv run pytest -q
